entries.dialogueText: "My explanation is this. The time has come for Brenas to submit to the Crown. Just as it has come for Valenqiris."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Now, now. I'm sure His Majesty has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, now. I'm sure His Majesty has an explanation..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thilence, Hubertuth.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thilence, Hubertuth."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty. That was uncalled fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. That was uncalled for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your blood ties to the King don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your blood ties to the King don't make you immune from justice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look at you. Speaking up to defend..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at you. Speaking up to defend me while preparing to drive a knife through my back."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Pardon me, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "Pardon me, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't owe an explanation to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't owe an explanation to you or anyone else. It is time for you to face judgement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't fool me, Hugo. I know yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't fool me, Hugo. I know you've always wanted my throne for yourself."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What judgement, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "What judgement, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you're my uncle. But honest..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you're my uncle. But honestly, I never could stand you."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You can't talk to my father like t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't talk to my father like that!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""For God's sake, Romus, please be r..."
entries.dialogueText: "For God's sake, Romus, please be reasonable!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We learned the wrong lessons from..."
entries.dialogueText: "We learned the wrong lessons from the War of Succession. Noble houses only lead to strife. The monarch must reign over all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My explanation is this. The time h..."
entries.dialogueText: "My explanation is this. The time has come for Valenqiris to submit to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Valenqiris, Your Majesty? I must h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valenqiris, Your Majesty? I must have misheard you..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Interesting. I recall such ravings..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting. I recall such ravings from the end of your father's life."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If you're implying what I think yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're implying what I think you are, you'll never get away with it."
